title: Recruitment
description: Measure enrichment of a fluorescence channel at parasite-associated regions relative to host-cell cytoplasm, with object filters, plate annotations, and per-PV and per-well summaries.
objectives: Map intensity channels and cell, nucleus, and parasite mask planes correctly.
Apply object and plate-level filters before calculating pathogen-to-cytoplasm recruitment.
Interpret real per-PV, per-well, control, overlay, and diagnostic outputs.
prerequisite: Run Measure with cell, nucleus, parasite, and cytoplasm tables plus merged arrays; define positive and negative control wells.

scenes.narration: Recruitment measures enrichment of a marker at parasite-associated regions relative to the surrounding host-cell cytoplasm. The console records resolved settings, filtering counts, output paths, figures, warnings, and errors; the chat box can discuss that context when AI is enabled.
scenes.speech_text: Recruitment measures enrichment of a marker at parasite associated regions relative to the surrounding host cell cytoplasm. scenes.narration: Choose or drop the experiment root containing measurements/measurements.db and the merged folder. This tutorial uses the transferred HeLa siRNA experiment, not synthetic data, with channel one—the ER signal—as the channel of interest.
scenes.speech_text: Choose or drop the experiment root containing measurements slash measurements dot D B and the merged folder. This tutorial uses the transferred HeLa S I R N A experiment, not synthetic data, with channel one, the E R signal, as the channel of interest.

scenes.narration: Essentials presents the source, channel mapping, filters, plate layout, and diagnostic choices needed for a first run. Confirm the map before tuning thresholds because a valid but wrong channel index can produce plausible, incorrect ratios.

scenes.narration: Modified shows only deliberate departures from defaults. Use it as a compact pre-run audit of the real experiment path, ER channel one, the three mask planes, area filters, control columns, and diagnostic choices.

scenes.narration: All settings exposes every control when reproducing or troubleshooting a run. Return to Essentials when the additional controls are not needed, so advanced values are not changed accidentally.

scenes.narration: Data Source contains the experiment root. Recruitment reads existing cell, nucleus, parasite, and cytoplasm measurements; it does not segment or remeasure images.
scenes.speech_text: Data Source contains the experiment root. Recruitment reads existing cell, nucleus, parasite, and cytoplasm measurements; it does not segment or remeasure images.

scenes.narration: Mask and Channel Mapping identifies every intensity plane and mask plane. Here cells use ER channel one and mask four, nuclei use channel zero and mask five, parasites use channel three and mask six, while recruitment is calculated on ER channel one.
scenes.speech_text: Mask and Channel Mapping identifies every intensity plane and mask plane. Here cells use E R channel one and mask four, nuclei use channel zero and mask five, parasites use channel three and mask six, while recruitment is calculated on E R channel one.

scenes.narration: Object Filtering gates cells, nuclei, and parasites by area and intensity, limits objects per cell, and requires enough cells per well. This run keeps cells above three thousand five hundred pixels, nuclei from seven hundred to four thousand, and parasites from one hundred to one thousand.
scenes.speech_text: Object Filtering gates cells, nuclei, and parasites by area and intensity, limits objects per cell, and requires enough cells per well. This run keeps cells above three thousand five hundred pixels, nuclei from seven hundred to four thousand, and parasites from one hundred to one thousand.

scenes.narration: Plate Layout and Controls maps biological labels to row or column identifiers. Column one is the positive control, column two is the negative control, and columns three through fourteen are screen wells; all rows are HeLa cells.
scenes.speech_text: Plate Layout and Controls maps biological labels to row or column identifiers. Column one is the positive control, column two is the negative control, and columns three through fourteen are screen wells; all rows are HeLa cells.

scenes.narration: Plots and Diagnostics controls segmentation overlays, control-intensity panels, figure size, and how many merged fields are sampled. Inspect the overlays before trusting a ratio, and compare controls before interpreting screen wells.
scenes.speech_text: Plots and Diagnostics controls segmentation overlays, control intensity panels, figure size, and how many merged fields are sampled. Inspect the overlays before trusting a ratio, and compare controls before interpreting screen wells.

scenes.narration: The complete channel map is visible here. Channel dimensions zero through three are available for diagnostics, but the primary recruitment score is pathogen channel-one mean intensity divided by cytoplasm channel-one mean intensity within the matched host cell.
scenes.speech_text: The complete channel map is visible here. Channel dimensions zero through three are available for diagnostics, but the primary recruitment score is pathogen channel one mean intensity divided by cytoplasm channel one mean intensity within the matched host cell.

scenes.narration: Click Run after checking source, map, filters, and controls. The backend joins the four measurement tables, annotates conditions, applies each object gate, calculates recruitment, groups wells, and queues diagnostic figures.
scenes.speech_text: Click Run after checking source, map, filters, and controls. The backend joins the four measurement tables, annotates conditions, applies each object gate, calculates recruitment, groups wells, and queues diagnostic figures.

scenes.narration: During execution, filtering counts in the console show exactly where objects are removed. Do not treat a large reduction as automatically good or bad; reconcile it with the intended area limits, control distributions, and sampled overlays.
scenes.speech_text: During execution, filtering counts in the console show exactly where objects are removed. Do not treat a large reduction as automatically good or bad; reconcile it with the intended area limits, control distributions, and sampled overlays.

scenes.narration: The real run retained thirty-nine thousand nine hundred thirty-seven PV-level rows across all one hundred ninety-six wells and produced five figures plus cells.csv and wells.csv. Mean well-level ER recruitment is one point three five four in the positive control, one point two eight one in the negative control, and one point three one eight in screen wells—a modest separation that should be judged with variability and image QC, not means alone.
